## Portraius Studio: design a character from text

The Characters screen's "Design from text": 4 candidate faces from a description, one pick, then the same turnaround sheet and views as a character made from photos (spec: Design from text).

1. Write the person in each **Candidate face** prompt, after "an original, fictional adult person:". The app puts your description in the same place.
2. Run. Nano Banana 2.1 draws the 4 faces at 1K, Fast, then the sheet from the first one.
3. To use another face, set **Picked face**'s batch_index (0 to 3) and run again. The candidates' seeds are fixed, so ComfyUI keeps them and only the sheet is drawn again.

Needs a Comfy account with credits: these are partner nodes.

nodes.title: Turnaround sheet
widgets_values:
Create a character reference sheet of the same person shown in the attached photos.
Keep their exact facial structure, skin tone and texture, hairline, hair, eye shape, and any
marks or features. Do not beautify, slim, smooth the skin or change their age.
Layout: one 16:9 image, plain mid-grey studio background, soft even front lighting, natural
skin texture with visible pores.
Panels left to right: front head-and-shoulders, three-quarter left, left profile, full body
standing front-facing in simple neutral clothing, and a strip of four expressions (neutral,
smile, surprised, serious).
No text, labels, borders or watermarks.
